The SPIRIT (Standard Protocol Items: Recommendations for Interventional
Trials) Statement provides evidence-based guidance for transparent and
comprehensive reporting of clinical trial protocols. The SPIRIT-Path
extension, published in 2021, addresses cellular and molecular
pathology-related content within trial protocols. Following the publication
of the updated SPIRIT Statement in 2025, revision and remapping of
SPIRIT-Path is required to ensure alignment with SPIRIT 2025 and to
incorporate contemporary clinical trial methodology, including emerging
areas such as digital pathology and artificial intelligence.
